notes.title: One week until release!
notes.notes:
Hi!

We are one week from release and we've been making huge steps in developing Rooftop Garden Simulator.
Next Monday, August first, we are going live :)

A small sum up of what we've been working on:
New level
New questline
New items
Improved building and growing system
Small bug fixes.

Because our game has changed so much, we are discontinuing the demo next week.

Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481701/2d0f24869190f0369cb8cdcd47d8f2bf42a7c80b.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481701/9e6862f0a899d6ddb71b49f76aa7f5e92bda2876.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42481701/a6f6ff5af6529c8a4120c8d9b05d5ded164120c6.png[/img][/url]

We can proudly tell you that the free to play demo of Rooftop Garden Simulator is live.
I hope you will enjoy this stripped down version of our game, and let us know in the hub!

Happy farming!
